sections.Profile:
Night Moves by International Concepts, released in 1989, is a cocktail-style pinball machine, designed by John Trudeau. It was part of a brief resurgence of cocktail pinball machines in the late '80s. Manufactured by Premier/Gottlieb but sold under the International Concepts brand, the machine features System 80B boards with under-playfield parts typical of Gottlieb designs.

- Manufacturer: International Concepts
- Years made: 1989
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Cocktail, Solid State, 1980s
